description: FriendliAI Model APIs provide pay-as-you-go serverless inference for a curated catalog of text, vision, and speech-to-text models through OpenAI-compatible and native API surfaces.
residency_notes: Friendli says inference requests and responses are not used for training or shared with third parties, but its privacy policy says AI inference information may be retained for up to one day after an organization or project is deleted. No API execution/storage region or Zero Data Retention control is documented.
prompt_training_notes: Friendli says it does not use the contents of inference requests and responses for any purpose other than providing its dedicated and serverless endpoints service to customers.

sources.notes: Live server-rendered catalog returned seven Model API models and their modalities.
Live pricing rate cards and context lengths.
Official API schema for Model APIs routes, authentication, parameters, and response formats.

verification.notes: Catalog, pricing, API base URL/authentication, modalities, and published data policy reconciled against FriendliAI primary sources. Public docs do not publish numeric self-serve rate limits or a fixed serverless execution/data region; enterprise offers contract-defined custom limits and regions.
